mapper.select: select p.id, p.name, u.username as sellerName, p.description, p.price, p.created_at as createdAt, p.img_store_path as imgPath, p.view_count as viewCount from cart_item ci join lxy_product p on p.id = ci.product_id join lxy_user u on u.id = p.uid where ci.user_id = #{userId} order by ci.created_at desc, ci.id desc
